reading_note: The teaching describes how divine truth (the Word) descends from its inward origin, is shaped by the discrete degrees of reception into a communicable form, and then circulates among spiritual beings as the medium of exchange. The double image — speech formed by mouth/tongue/teeth/lips and a coin shaped by five artisans — together expresses the single arc: interior truth must be ultimated through ordered degrees before it can pass between minds and serve as the currency of spiritual community. The arc moves from the inward begetting of truth, through its formation in the bodily/natural ultimates, into its hearing and reception by others, and finally to its circulation as the common coin by which spiritual goods are taken and given.

segments.spiritual_sense: Concerning the form in which divine truth clothes itself for transmission: what is its nature.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the form in which divine truth becomes communicable

segments.spiritual_sense: Concerning the begetting of divine truth, which {1} proceeds from its inward source toward expression.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the proceeding of divine truth from its interior origin into form

segments.spiritual_sense: It comes forth from the organ of utterance — the doctrinal ultimate by which interiors are externalized — and others receive it {4} in the {5} organs of obedient reception.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the ultimate by which interior truth is uttered
reception in obedience

segments.spiritual_sense: The {7} of the inward breath, which is the very life of perception, draws truth toward itself; and the affirming faculty —

key_correspondences.spiritual: the spirit or living perception that bears truth
the faculty that affirms and confesses truth

segments.spiritual_sense: — spreads it abroad into articulate distinction; and the natural truths divide and discriminate it as teeth divide; and the outermost doctrinal ultimates {9}

key_correspondences.spiritual: the faculty distributing truth into articulated forms
natural truths that distinguish and divide
the outermost ultimates of doctrine

segments.spiritual_sense: draw it inward, while divine truth itself comes forth through the operative power of the {11} — that influx which moves all the organs of utterance.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the operative divine influx animating expression

segments.spiritual_sense: — through all the members and ultimate organs; and others hear it from without, according to the {13} order of reception established by the Divine.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the organic ultimates through which truth is mediated
reception of truth from without when it has been ultimated

segments.spiritual_sense: It is as with the coin which is the medium of common exchange: namely, one degree of formation engraves the first imprint upon it, and an{15}other —

key_correspondences.spiritual: truth in the form fit to circulate as the medium of spiritual exchange

segments.spiritual_sense: — a second engraves further upon it; and another rounds and bounds its circumference; and an{17}other —

key_correspondences.spiritual: successive degrees shaping truth into definite form

segments.spiritual_sense: — sets upon it the authoritative seal of divine confirmation; and another forges the very body of the blank substrate that receives all these — {19}

key_correspondences.spiritual: the divine signature of authority and authenticity
the ultimate substrate of nature that receives the imprint of truth

segments.spiritual_sense: These five artisans — the five discrete degrees of reception, from inmost to outermost — together adorn and form {21} the truth into its finished shape.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the five discrete degrees (celestial through natural) that successively form truth

segments.spiritual_sense: — the coin; and it goes forth into the midst of men, and serves as the cur{23}rency by which spiritual goods are exchanged in community.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the spiritual community in which truth circulates
the common medium by which spiritual goods are given and received

segments.spiritual_sense: And they take and they give by means of it — for truth in formed shape is what makes spiritual reciprocity possible. Just so is it likewise with this {25}divine word —

key_correspondences.spiritual: the reciprocal communication of goods through truth

segments.spiritual_sense: — that as it is formed inwardly and adorned there within, in the five {27} discrete degrees of the mind,

key_correspondences.spiritual: the five discrete degrees of reception within the inward man
truth perfected through every degree before utterance

segments.spiritual_sense: so it comes forth into ultimate utterance, being heard before the organs of obedient reception {29}

key_correspondences.spiritual: the faculty of obedient reception in others

segments.spiritual_sense: of others — passing thus from one mind into another as the very currency of heaven.

key_correspondences.spiritual: fellow recipients in the spiritual community
